requirement.title: Cut-in response
requirement.text: If a vehicle from an adjacent lane cuts into the ego lane at least 15 m ahead of the ego vehicle, the ego vehicle shall not collide, and from 6 s after the cut-in starts the time headway shall be at least 1.0 s.

scenario.rationale: A slower vehicle starts cutting in from an adjacent lane at a 15 m bumper gap, testing collision avoidance and a minimum 1.0 s headway from six seconds after cut-in initiation.

gt.activation_note: cut-in at t=3.0s with approx. gap 15 m (needs >=15 m, >=8 s after)
gt.label: correct & effective

scenario.rationale: A slower vehicle starts cutting in from an adjacent lane exactly 15 m ahead at t=0, testing collision avoidance and recovery to at least 1.0 s headway from t=6 onward.

gt.activation_note: cut-in at t=0.0s with approx. gap 15 m (needs >=15 m, >=8 s after)
gt.label: correct & effective
